Calling updateData inside updateData on the same DataStore instance is not supported
since updates made in the parent updateData call will not be visible to the nested
updateData call. See https://issuetracker.google.com/issues/241760537 for details.
Kotlin reflection is not yet supported for synthetic Java properties. Please follow/upvote https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KT-55980
This is a bug in DataStore. Please file a bug at: https://issuetracker.google.com/issues/new?component=907884&template=1466542

intelligence_report.banking_impact_assessment: The application carries a banking impact score of 20.0 based on structural analysis; however, static checks indicate no specific Indian banking target packages were directly flagged, and no regulatory context violations were identified.
cert_in_recommendations: Verify APK source before deployment in enterprise environment
Monitor device network traffic for connections to flagged URLs
Run APK in controlled sandbox for dynamic behavioral analysis
intelligence_report.customer_advisory_draft: Download applications exclusively from official app stores like Google Play. Do not grant broad device permissions or share One-Time Passwords (OTPs) with unverified survey apps.
intelligence_report.fraud_objective: Potential interception or visual manipulation of sensitive OTP entry screens.
intelligence_report.plain_english_narrative: The application ai.agribid.esurvey_farmer is an unclassified package that returned a risk score of 8.96. Visual analysis detected weak brand color matches and OTP text references related to Punjab National Bank (PNB ONE), though visual detection rules were not triggered. Dynamic analysis observed runtime accessibility events (AccessibilityManager.sendAccessibilityEvent), but no network connections were established during testing.
recommended_actions: Execute extended interactive dynamic testing in a controlled sandbox to monitor for latent network connections or concealed payloads.
Add package name ai.agribid.esurvey_farmer to internal threat monitoring lists for ongoing observation.
Review mobile banking gateway logs for anomalous session activity associated with accessibility-based interactions.
